methods.inventory: Current VeraCompiler AST: buildStd*Module new ExternalFunction literal first arguments; dynamic UI and gfx entries from actual source-loader CATALOG and GFX_FUNCTIONS exports.
methods.scope: All namespace-callable functions in current compiler std module builders, including UI helpers/components, gfx and sdk.call. Classes, fields, instance methods, intrinsics, SDK target strings and device implementations are not API inventory entries.
methods.scanner: TypeScript CallExpression/PropertyAccessExpression AST with namespace import symbol identity and compiler PRELUDE_NAMES. Lexical shadowing is excluded. Comments, string/regex/template literal text and non-call references are excluded; real template interpolations are scanned. Indirect calls and computed property calls are not resolved.
methods.counting: Distinct record IDs per callable overall and per splits.json assignment; repeated call sites are occurrences, not additional units. Candidate mappings and upstream source uses never count as translated calls.
methods.evidence: Fresh host compiler and VM execution of current encoded test files, with a fresh VM per case and argument immutability checks when requested. Curated plus validation cases are matched to record metadata. Published source/test hashes and stdlib details are checked against active files.
methods.limitations: Lexical presence is not runtime call coverage: dead branches and uncalled helpers count. Compile and behavior evidence is per program/test, not call tracing. Upstream source hashes are format/metadata checked, not recomputed; recorded signature reviews are cross-checked, not an upstream checker rerun. No device execution, rendering, network, cloud, or SDK target success is claimed.
methods.sourceLoader: Host-only current application exports; no device calls.
